content_text: I understand it’s not a relevant problem, but i think the forum template could include the usual “edit” function to correct posts once published. Not a big issue and It’s Just a suggestion, but I’m a (science) teacher and correcting errors it’s a compulsory behaviour for me, ah ah ah. 😀
